VENICE_API_KEY.description: API key used for authenticating requests to the Venice AI service.

VENICE_SMALL_MODEL.description: Identifier of the small language model to be used by the Venice plugin.

VENICE_LARGE_MODEL.description: Identifier of the large language model to be used by the Venice plugin.

VENICE_IMAGE_MODEL.description: Identifier of the image generation model to be used by the Venice plugin (e.g., fluently-xl).

VENICE_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Identifier of the Venice embedding model to generate text embeddings (e.g., text-embedding-bge-m3).

VENICE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.description: Number of dimensions expected in the generated text embeddings.

VENICE_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the Venice AI API requests.

VENICE_TTS_MODEL.description: The Venice TTS model to use for text-to-speech generation.

VENICE_TTS_VOICE.description: The voice to use for TTS (e.g., af_sky, am_echo, bf_emma). See Venice docs for full list.

VENICE_TTS_SPEED.description: The speed of generated audio (0.25 to 4.0).

VENICE_TTS_FORMAT.description: The audio format (mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm).

VENICE_TTS_STREAMING.description: Whether to stream audio sentence by sentence.
